criteria.reason: Explicitly discloses April 2023 knowledge cutoff and advises verifying with current sources.
Names Amherd for 2023, which is incorrect (Berset held 2023; Amherd 2024); omits Parmelin for 2026.
Directs user to the official Swiss government website to confirm current information.

factual_errors: Claims Viola Amherd was President in 2023; Alain Berset was the 2023 President (Amherd served 2024).
summary: Response properly discloses its cutoff, yearly rotation, and an official source, but gives a factually wrong name-year (Amherd for 2023) and fails to name Parmelin for 2026.
